excerpt.span_text:
Under Secretary Hooker. Thank you, Chairman. Thank you 
again for the opportunity to appear before this body and to 
have the opportunity to tell a good news story, actually.
    And first of all, I would like to just reject the premise 
that the reorganization that Secretary Rubio has undertaken, an 
historic reorganization that he has undertaken at the 
Department of State, was haphazard. It was not haphazard, it 
was methodical, it was considered.
    It was conducted by engaging senior leadership at the Under 
Secretary level that is in both career and political. It was 
conducted by engaging the workforce, and which we talked about 
here today, that more 650 comments went into the consideration.
    It was conducted to streamline redundancies and meet the 
needs of our foreign policy going forward to eliminate some of 
the waste, some of the inefficiencies that you have actually 
also mentioned and your colleagues have mentioned here today.
    And we are on the way to doing that. The Secretary has 
taken great strides by eliminating these offices. As I 
mentioned, these were done, these reorganization steps were 
taken in a way where they are not personal, were not 
individual.
    They were aimed at streamlining functions, streamlining our 
efforts to make sure that both the President's priorities and 
the interests of the American people are being met in the most 
efficient way possible.
    I also want to answer the assertion that we have now a lack 
of expertise at the State Department. There are still thousands 
of experts, who also speak Mandarin, at the department, and who 
are working every day to, with great pride, working every day 
to implement the foreign policy of this great nation.
    And so some of your colleagues have just mentioned with the 
elimination of certain offices, that that expertise was just 
lost forever. No, there are other experts that are working on 
these issues. These functions have been integrated.
    And as I said, I commit to working with this body to answer 
some of the questions that you have raised today that maybe I 
didn't have the answers in front of me. But it would be my 
great honor to do that. As it is my great honor to return to 
the State Department in this role to serve President Trump and 
to serve Secretary Rubio.
    And with that, sir, I would just like to say thank you very 
much.
